comments: Calculated from ery_hctz5po_4_cpm: c [nmol/l] = A [cpm/ml] x 1000 ml/l / 1322 dpm/nmol. Specific activity of the oral dose: 10 µCi in 5 mg 14C-hct (Methods), 2 µCi/mg x 2.22e6 dpm/µCi x 297.74 mg/mmol = 1.322e9 dpm/mmol = 1322 dpm/nmol. The counting efficiency is not reported and is taken as 1 (cpm = dpm), so the values are lower bounds by the efficiency. Label is hct: more than 95 % of the urinary label is unchanged hct (Results). This replaces the format 1 conversion cpm/38480000 (the maximum specific activity of 14C, 62.4 mCi/mmol = 2.31 GBq/mmol, divided by 60 instead of multiplied by 60 for counts per minute), which put the plasma and erythrocyte concentrations 29 times too low and the urinary excretion 343 times too high.
